title: QBI §199A Deduction Optimizer
description: Estimate the 20% qualified business income deduction under §199A (OBBBA-permanent), model the SSTB phase-out, and show the W-2 wage / UBIA optimization lever for higher earners.
regulatory_citations: IRC §199A (as amended by OBBBA, signed July 4, 2025 — made permanent)
2026 minimum deduction: $400 if QBI ≥ $1,000 from active trade or business
